description: This file defines the EmployeeWorkExperienceAPI class which provides RESTful API endpoints for managing employee work experience records within an HRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations (create, retrieve, update, delete), validation rules, and interaction with the service layer. The class handles request parameters, response formatting, and integration with OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceAPI
classes.description: A RESTful API class for handling CRUD operations and validation related to employee work experience records in the HRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkExperienceService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeWorkExperienceService instance used for business logic operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single employee work experience record based on employee number and experience ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne request, primarily verifying the experience ID and employee number.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employee work experience records, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing employee experience records, including employee number and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new employee work experience record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new experience record, requiring employer and job title, optional dates and comments.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines shared validation rules for the request body during creation and updating of experience records.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing employee work experience record identified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an experience record, requiring a valid ID and other fields.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more employee work experience records based on supplied IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deletion, specifically checking for employee number and record IDs.

methods.name: saveEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Creates or updates an EmpWorkExperience entity based on request parameters and persists it via DAO.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Validation rule ensuring the employee number is within accessible range.
